message.content: {"verdict": "revise", "score": 0.62, "reasons": ["Artifact is truncated: the 'Performance metrics' table ends with 'Min' and the document cuts off mid-table.", "Several required sections are missing or underdeveloped (sizing/installation considerations; costs and running costs with example savings; noise/space requirements; maintenance/lifetime; UK policy/grant support with primary-source links; FAQs).", "References section exists as a heading, but no full reference list; inline links are present but data needs up-to-date UK sources with citations (as of 2026) from BEIS, GOV.UK, Energy Saving Trust, manufacturer datasheets, and independent tests.", "Some values (e.g., SCOP ranges) are stated without explicit, traceable UK sources and dates; needs verification and consistent citation."], "guidance": "Complete the document by finishing the truncated table and filling all missing sections with up-to-date UK data. Add sizing/installation guidance tailored to typical UK homes, detailed cost ranges (purchase and installation), running costs with example savings versus gas/oil, noise and space requirements (in dB and footprint), maintenance needs and expected lifetime. Expand policy/grant support with direct links to primary sources (BEIS Boiler Upgrade Scheme, GOV.UK pages, Energy Saving Trust, local incentives) and include a comprehensive FAQs section addressing common homeowner misconceptions. Provide a final, well-structured References list with complete URLs to government, industry bodies, and manufacturer datasheets. Ensure the file remains in a structured Markdown format with clear sections and properly formatted tables."}
